title: STAR: SocioTechnical Approach to Red Teaming Language Models
benchmark_measurement: Post-hoc identification of religious groups mentioned or harmed during red teaming dialogues. Religion was an available demographic label for annotators, but not a primary target for attack generation in the described study.
findings: The study did not report specific findings related to religion. Religion was included as a demographic category for participant recruitment and for post-hoc annotation of dialogues. The authors note that red teaming against more complex demographic intersections, including religion, would be a valuable area for future work.
